description: Foundational complex-number drills: powers of i, a+bi arithmetic (sums/products/quotients/conjugates), solving quadratics in C, and converting a+bi values to trigonometric (modulus-argument) form.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 1: ចំនួនកុំផ្លិច (Complex Numbers) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: Reduce exponent mod 4 to evaluate powers of i (i^0=1, i^1=i, i^2=-1, i^3=-i), then combine
Standard a+bi arithmetic: expand, rationalize denominators by multiplying by the conjugate, simplify
Substitute given z, z' and simplify using conjugate/reciprocal/power rules
Quadratic in C: negative discriminant, roots are conjugate pair (-b\pm i\sqrt{|\Delta|})/(2a)
Equate real and imaginary parts of both sides to solve for real x, y
Compute modulus r=|z| and argument \theta=\arg z, write z=r(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta); for powers, apply De Moivre first

exercises.prompt_latex: z_1=-1+i\sqrt3,\ z_2=1-i\sqrt3;\ a=\sqrt3/2-i/2,\ b=2+2\sqrt3 i;\ z_1=1+i\sqrt3,\ z_2=6(\cos\pi/4-i\sin\pi/4);\ Z=(\sqrt3+i\sqrt3)(\cos\pi/3+i\sin\pi/3);\ z_1=1+i,\ z_2=1+\sqrt3 i;\ a=1+2\sqrt3+3i,\ b=1-2\sqrt3-i;\ A=\frac{2(1+i)^2}{1-i\sqrt3}
exercises.technique: Multi-part: compute sum/difference/product/quotient of two complex numbers then express results in trig form, using cos(7\pi/12), sin(7\pi/12) via angle-addition

exercises.technique: Multi-part: solve quadratic in C, find modulus/argument of roots, verify roots satisfy a cubic, compute high powers via trig form

exercises.technique: Multi-part word-style problems combining trig form, conjugates, and solving for unknown real coefficients m,n
Simplify square roots of negative numbers as i\sqrt{positive}, then combine with a+bi arithmetic
